text: Countdown Days（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：在 DSH 侧栏记录生日、纪念日、还款日等重要日期，并查看距离下一次日期还有多久。插件通过侧栏面板提供新增、编辑、删除、置顶、搜索和分类筛选；日期可用公历或农历，支持相应的重复方式。用户可设置提前天数和提醒时间，页面运行时显示到期提示，并可启用浏览器桌面通知。设置面板还支持 JSON 备份导入和导出。适合希望在 DSH 网页界面整理个人日期提醒的用户。记录保存在当前浏览器的 localStorage，农历换算依赖浏览器 ICU 中国历法；没有代码证据表明需要 API key 或外部账号。

Countdown Days adds a DSH web sidebar for birthdays and other dates. Track solar or lunar countdowns, search and filter entries, and set reminders. The page can show in-app and browser notifications. JSON backup import and export are included. Records stay in this browser’s localStorage.
想在 DSH 里记生日和纪念日，到日子前提醒我。
DSH 网页能不能做一个农历倒数日清单？
I want to keep countdowns for important dates in my DSH sidebar.
Countdown Days 的功能「日期倒数与分类」：在侧栏添加生日、纪念日、还款日等条目，选择公历或农历及可用的重复方式；列表可搜索、按分类筛选并置顶。
Countdown Days 的功能「提醒与备份」：为日期设置提前天数和时间，页面运行时显示到期提示，并可启用浏览器通知；设置中可将记录导出为 JSON 或从 JSON 导入替换现有记录。

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · 中文：在 DSH 里记住生日、纪念日和还款日。支持公历、农历（含闰月）、重复日期、分类、置顶和提醒，无云同步。

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/Veagau/dsh-countdown-days/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-countdown-days.tgz
```

也可请目标 Web 实例中的 agent 调用上述工具。

**本地开发安装**：克隆仓库并保留目录，请 agent 用 `plugin_manager` 安装绝对路径：

```json
{"action":"install_bundle","target":"<countdown-days 目录的绝对路径>"}
```

安装影响当前 profile 的所有会话。检查返回的 `application` 和 `warnings`，按提示刷新，再从侧边栏打开「倒数日」。Windows JSON 路径中的反斜杠写成 `\\`；本地链接安装后不要删除源码目录。需要支持 bundle 的 Harness。资产若尚不存在，请勿改用来源不明的下载；参见[分发与发布指南](docs/distribution.md)。

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · 添加日子：1. 点击「新建倒数日」，填写名称和分类。
2. 选择公历或农历日期，设置重复方式。
3. 选择提前提醒天数和时间，保存。

公历支持每周、每月或每年重复；农历支持每年重复，换算依赖浏览器 ICU 中国历法。列表支持搜索、编辑、删除和置顶。

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · 开启提醒：1. 在设置中打开「桌面通知」，启用定时提醒检查。
2. 允许浏览器通知，并检查系统通知权限。
3. 点击「发送测试提醒」确认通知能显示。

页面需要持续加载；关页、休眠或后台限制可能漏报。当天提示条不受通知开关影响。重要事项请保留其他提醒方式。

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · 备份与恢复：1. 在设置中导出 JSON 备份。
2. 恢复前先备份当前记录，再导入文件。
3. 确认替换：**导入会覆盖全部现有记录，不会合并**。

数据和备份未加密。清除站点数据、更换浏览器或来源地址可能丢失记录；通知可能出现在锁屏上，请勿填写敏感内容。

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · English：Track birthdays, anniversaries and payment dates in DSH. Supports Gregorian and Chinese lunar dates (including leap months), recurrence, categories, pinning and reminders. No cloud sync.

The current fallback is the [GitHub Release tgz (v1.0.1)](https://github.com/Veagau/dsh-countdown-days/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-countdown-days.tgz), not an npm registry installation.

dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/Veagau/dsh-countdown-days/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-countdown-days.tgz
```

Alternatively, ask the agent in the target Web instance to call the tool above.

**Local development installation**: clone and keep the repository, then ask the agent to install its absolute path:

{"action":"install_bundle","target":"<absolute path to countdown-days>"}
```

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · Install：Installation affects all sessions in the current profile. Check `application` and `warnings`, follow refresh instructions, then open **Countdown Days** from the sidebar. Escape Windows path backslashes as `\\` in JSON; keep the source directory for local linked installs. Requires a bundle-capable Harness. If the asset is not available yet, do not substitute an untrusted download; see the [distribution guide](docs/distribution.md).

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · Add an event：1. Select **Add countdown** and enter a name and category.
2. Choose a Gregorian or lunar date and recurrence.
3. Set reminder days and time, then save.

Gregorian dates repeat weekly, monthly or yearly; lunar dates repeat yearly and require the browser's ICU Chinese calendar. Search, edit, delete and pin events from the list.

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · Enable reminders：1. Turn on **Desktop notifications** in Settings to enable scheduled checks.
2. Allow browser notifications and check system notification permissions.
3. Send a test reminder to check that notifications appear.

The page must stay loaded. Closing it, device sleep or background restrictions can cause missed reminders. The today banner works independently of the notification switch. Keep another reminder for important events.

@local/dsh-countdown-days README · Back up and restore：1. Export a JSON backup from Settings.
2. Back up current events before importing a file.
3. Confirm replacement: **import replaces all existing events; it does not merge them**.

Data and backups are unencrypted. Clearing site data or changing browser or origin can lose records. Notifications may appear on the lock screen; avoid sensitive content.
